name: H Kenkyuukai
source:
Main character entered secret high school "H Research Group" as the first male member. 
Three girls & female teachers are eager to set multiple experiments regarding the object of study on daily basis. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公加入高中里的秘密社团“H研究会”，成为创会以来第一名男性成员。3名少女与女教师每天都兴致勃勃，围绕研究对象设计出一项又一项实验。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vndb-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
